description.value: Beauty For Ashes is a specialty African grocery and beauty products store stocking authentic items difficult to find elsewhere in the Lower Mainland, including palm oil, dried and frozen fish, pap/ogi, kenkey, and a wide variety of herbs, spices, and health and beauty products sourced from across the African continent. The store operates from Surrey and Burnaby locations and offers online ordering with in-store pickup at both sites. It serves a broad African diaspora community and bills itself as the finest African grocery store in the region.
